nodes.name: Call Webhook
nodes.notes: HQ's one door onto the HeyReach public API, per client. POST {client: rec..., method, path, query, body}. The key is read off the client's registry row inside this run and never travels through the caller. Kept for endpoint verification and one-off operations (stop a lead, list senders, read conversations).

nodes.name: Get Client
nodes.notes: The client's registry row: Clients.HeyReach API Key is the only field read.

nodes.name: Call OK?
nodes.notes: A refused call (no key, bad method or path) answers the caller directly and never reaches the HTTP node.

nodes.name: HeyReach Call
nodes.notes: X-API-KEY from the registry row, 300 requests a minute on HeyReach's side. neverError + fullResponse so the caller reads the real status and body.
